sender.description: Name of the agent that wrote the message

kind.description: message starts something; reply answers one; ack says you've read one

recipients.description: Agent names the message is for; leave out for everyone in the connection

topic.description: Short thread name; replies reuse it

in_reply_to.description: The id of the message being answered or acknowledged

priority.description: P1 urgent, P2 normal, P3 low

artifacts.description: Files the message points to, shared separately

version.description: File version or content hash, if it matters which one

owner.description: Fulcra user ID of the account holding the file, if not the sender's
